pythonMissing.title: Python 3.10+ required
pythonMissing.description: Music Manager needs a recent Python for its download and library engine. Install it with Homebrew, then check again.

setup.title: Preparing the environment
setup.description: The app will create an isolated Python environment and install yt-dlp and beets into it. Your system Python is left untouched.

ready.title: Everything is ready
ready.description: The environment is in place. You can start filling your library.
